protection: Foundation implementer has no write permission to acceptance/contracts; changes require separately leased acceptance author plus independent review and version bump.
test_data_policy: All fixtures synthetic and local. Fake effects prove reconciliation semantics only, never real GitHub/Linear delivery. Do not use real credentials or existing services.

scenarios.action: Admit and commit a synthetic run, close the store, reopen via a fresh owner.
assertions: Recorded input identities and state are identical after reopen.
Committed event ordering and immutable identities survive restart; no agent transcript is required.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

scenarios.action: Race A/B for one run; expire the winner, let the other acquire a strictly newer fencing token; have old owner try transition and effect intent.
assertions: Exactly one initial claim succeeds.
New lease is valid and old owner cannot commit state/event/effect mutations.
A failed stale mutation leaves state and event count unchanged.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

scenarios.action: Interrupt transaction before commit, then separately after committed intent but before dispatch; reopen each state.
assertions: Uncommitted transition/event/intent is absent as a unit.
Committed intent survives and has no fabricated success receipt.
Dispatch is impossible without a committed intent and current owner.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

setup.transport: local controlled fake with independently persisted object ledger

scenarios.action: Dispatch committed intent; let remote ledger accept once; lose response and kill owner before receipt. Restart and reconcile by operation identity. Repeat with unreadable ledger.
assertions: Confirmed ledger case links one existing object and stores confirmed receipt without a second create.
Unreadable/ambiguous case remains unresolved/waiting and cannot blindly repeat or claim success.
Same operation key with changed payload is rejected or requires a new explicit operation; old receipt cannot satisfy it.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

scenarios.action: Persist cancellation; attempt to start a new command and effect; reconcile the previously sent effect.
assertions: No new command or external effect begins after cancellation is effective.
Owned child and descendant terminate within the configured cleanup bound; unrelated sentinel stays alive.
Previously sent effect may be reconciled and recorded without being sent again.
Cancellation and retained partial output survive reopen.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

scenarios.action: Record a passing receipt/artifact; attempt overwrite; change head, scope, scenario/fixture, command/toolchain individually; tamper artifact bytes and separately remove artifact.
assertions: Content-addressed identity cannot silently change under the same receipt.
Each relevant changed input invalidates its dependent receipt.
Tampered/missing artifact is explicit integrity/missing evidence failure and cannot satisfy pass.
Unchanged receipt remains readable; unrelated display/report retry does not require rerunning valid code checks.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

setup.command_behavior: write unique marker to stdout and stderr; spawn owned descendant; wait indefinitely

scenarios.action: Run command to timeout, then repeat with explicit cancellation and with output exceeding configured cap.
assertions: Outcome distinguishes timeout, cancellation and success; a timeout is never success.
Both pre-timeout markers survive as bounded partial logs and truncation is explicit.
Owned descendants exit within cleanup bound; no orphan remains.
Unrelated sentinel is never signalled or killed.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

scenarios.action: Kill worker while command is running; reclaim after lease expiry and inspect retained process identity; repeat when identity cannot be safely established.
assertions: New owner reconciles owned process state instead of launching a duplicate.
Uncertain ownership yields recovery-required and does not kill an arbitrary PID.
Unpublished workspace sentinel and prior evidence remain intact.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

scenarios.action: Attempt resume with incompatible worker, then with matching compatible worker.
assertions: Incompatible worker stops at explicit compatibility/migration boundary before commands or effects.
Original versions remain unchanged; compatible worker can resume the recorded stage.
No implicit migration or replay from workflow start occurs.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

scenarios.action: Validate effective config, inspect exported diagnostics/provenance, package and install in a clean local temporary prefix using the documented procedure.
assertions: Invalid values fail before admission; effective values name their source.
Credential references are handled separately; synthetic secret never appears in public diagnostics/artifacts.
Installed command reports source commit/build identity matching package manifest; no source checkout dependency.
This proves local package behavior only; no live deployment is claimed.
scenarios.implementation_boundary: Exercise foundation primitives with local fixtures; full coordinator/browser/remote integration remains in later tickets.

assertions: CI polling can retain valid historical browser evidence without claiming the service is currently ready.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: Wrong password, consumed 2FA, initialized setup DB
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: Named fixture failure or reproducible reset; no fabricated UI pass.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: UI save looks successful without persistence
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: Reload or authoritative read fails product acceptance.
Trace/logs retained, owned cleanup, one bounded known recipe retry.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: Disk full, worker killed, competing launch
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: No unpublished loss, correct admission/lease recovery, no duplicate owner.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: CI fails with unavailable logs after review exhausted
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: Failure plus diagnostics-unavailable retained; protected CI repair/escalation reachable.
Same receipt supplied, stable finding and one arbitration; bounded no-op loop.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: Head/scope changes after screenshot/review/approval, or approval revoked
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: Stale receipts rejected before handoff/merge; new scope/head needs fresh evidence/authority.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: API succeeds but response lost; crash before/after push, draft, publication, merge and receipt
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: Existing object/effect reconciled before retry; no duplicate or invented success.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: Cancel around unsent and already-sent effects
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: No further sends; sent effects reconciled; unpublished data/evidence retained.
Compatible resume or explicit migration boundary, not silent version substitution.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: PR head differs from merge-group/integration SHA
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: Both identities and relationship retained; actual required merge-group checks enforced.
Merged/closeout-pending or report-pending stays distinct; no coding replay.

eventual_adversarial_scenarios.stimulus: Daemon stops while persisted header says running
eventual_adversarial_scenarios.required_result: Console distinguishes historical state from absent live owner and states next action.
Named unsupported drift; no invented replacement or relaxed required check.

execution_rules: Exercise the public module interface; do not make acceptance depend on private SQLite table or function names.
Use separate worker processes for actual kill/reopen cases; a mocked exception alone is insufficient crash proof.
Deterministic fake clock is allowed for store expiry; command/process termination needs actual disposable local processes.
Specify executable invocation and retained artifact paths when implementation exists; this contract intentionally contains no invented executable command.
Validation output must record contract hash, tested commit/build, command and exit status, individual assertions, artifacts, unresolved gaps.
Independent evaluator verifies contract hashes before/after attempts and lives outside coding-agent writable target scope.
Every full-workflow A-case must later have real integration coverage where applicable; foundation passes cannot satisfy live requirements.
